# Known failures for behavioral execution conformance tests
# Remove entries when implementation is complete

# Semantic-oracle cases whose library-derived expectation the executor does not
# meet yet; the derivations are in docs/project/behavior-semantic-oracle.md.
# A node reached over two successions is performed once per arriving token.
action_node_with_two_incoming_successions_runs_once
# A join fires on the count of parked tokens, not one per incoming succession.
action_join_one_token_per_incoming_succession
# A merge admits one traversal per executor run, so a loop's re-entry is dropped.
action_merge_loop_reenters
